  /kallax-review-pr [PR]     Review PR (5 levels Gate Review)

  /kallax-skill [name]       Execute a specific skill

  kallax verify:output        Verify task output (5 levels)
  kallax system doctor        Run system diagnostics
  kallax team:status          Show team overview
